# Data loading

```{r}

string.names <- function(vector){
  for(i in 1:length(names(vector))){
    names(vector)[i] <- paste0("V_", names(vector)[i])
  }
  return(names(vector))
}

```



# Blacklist arcs continu -> discret
# Declare BN object based on data

```{r}

disc <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
cont <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

set.seed(42)
blacklist <- expand.grid(from = cont, to = disc)

bn <- hc(
  data,
  score = "bic-cg",
  blacklist = blacklist
)

# bn_fitted <- bn.fit(bn, data, method = "mle-cg") 


```





```{r}

R <- 500
set.seed(42)

start.time <- Sys.time()
arcs.list.boot <- bn.boot(
  data = data, 
  R = R, 
  
  m = nrow(data),
  algorithm = "hc",  
  algorithm.args = list(score = "bic-cg", blacklist = blacklist), 
  statistic = arcs)


end.time <- Sys.time()
end.time -start.time

```




```{r}

3.5*3600/100


```



# Compute arcs frequency

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)

combined_df <- do.call(rbind, arcs.list.boot)
combined_df <- as.data.frame(combined_df)

combined_df <- combined_df %>% group_by_all() %>% count
combined_df$freq <- combined_df$freq/R
combined_df_kept <- combined_df[combined_df$freq >= 0.9,]

combined_df[combined_df$from %in% names(data_disc),]
combined_df[combined_df$to == "height",]
combined_df_kept

```


```{r}

DAG.path <- "datas/MorphoMNIST/_10/arcs/bn_boot-R_1k-m_10k.csv"
write.csv(combined_df, DAG.path)

```


# Select arcs
## Linearly decreasing -> identification of threshold according to the log-likelyhood

```{r}

# load bootstrapped arcs
DAG.path <- "datas/MorphoMNIST/5_10/arcs/bn_boot-R_1k-m_10k.csv"
df.arcs <- read.csv(DAG.path, row.names = 1)

nb.arcs <- c()
bn.score <- c()
log.lik <- c()

range <- 61:99
for(i in range){
  # first time -> number of arcs according to the threshold
  df.arcs.robust <- df.arcs[df.arcs$freq > i/100, ]
  nb.arcs <- c(nb.arcs, nrow(df.arcs.robust))
  
  # second time -> number of arcs according the log-likelyhood
  # set the selected arcs
  arcs(bn) <- df.arcs.robust[, 1:2]
  bn.score <- c(bn.score, score(bn, data, type = "bic-cg"))
  
  # TRAIN BN
  bn.fitted <- bn.fit(bn, data, method = "mle-cg") 
  log.lik <- c(log.lik, logLik(bn.fitted, data))
}




```

```{r}

plot(range, nb.arcs)
plot(nb.arcs, log.lik)

plot(range, log.lik, type = "o", lty = 3, col = "blue", xlab = "threshold (> x%)", ylab = "score", ylim = c(min(bn.score), max(log.lik)))
lines(range, bn.score, type = "o", lty = 3, col = "red")
legend(85, max(log.lik)*1.005, c("log-likelyhood", "bic-cg"), lty = c(3, 3), col = c("blue", "red"))
grid()


```





```{r}



df.arcs.robust.inf <- df.arcs[df.arcs$freq > 64/100, ]
df.arcs.robust.sup <- df.arcs[df.arcs$freq > 65/100, ]



nrow(df.arcs.robust.inf)
nrow(df.arcs.robust.sup)

arcs(bn) <- df.arcs.robust.inf[, 1:2]
score(bn, data, type = "bic-cg")

arcs(bn) <- df.arcs.robust.sup[, 1:2]
score(bn, data, type = "bic-cg")



```




```{r}

df.arcs.robust <- df.arcs[df.arcs$freq > 0.99, ]

# load BOOTSTRAP ARCS in BN
arcs(bn) <- df.arcs.robust[, 1:2]

# TRAIN BN
bn.fitted <- bn.fit(bn, data, method = "mle-cg") 
graphviz.plot(bn.fitted)

```
